newsitem.title: MALTA: Maltese bourse steady, Lombard Malta firms.
newsitem.headline: Maltese bourse steady, Lombard Malta firms.

text.p: The Maltese share index was little changed at Wednesday's session. Major banks were steady, though Lombard Bank Malta saw average share prices rise three cents.
Turnover in the once weekly session on Wednesday reached 313,300 Maltese Lira ($877,800) down from 463,000 Maltese Lira in the previous week.
Trading was spread over 87 deals, 29 in equities and 58 in fixed income securities. The value of the share index rose by 3.9 to 1,013.36.
Business in equities amounted to just under 88,200 Maltese Lira, with 60,511 shares transacted. Of these 13,666 were Bank of Valetta shares trading for an average 125 cents per share, unchanged.
Heavy trading in Lombard Bank Malta saw 23,645 shares selling for an average 154 cents per share from 151 cents per share last week. Trading in Lombard closed at 1.58.
There was one deal in Middle Sea Insurance with 500 shares selling for an average 122 cents each, down eigh mils.
In the government bond market, 14 issues were dealt in, turnover reaching just under 200,000 Maltese Lira. Business was mainly in the 7.75 percent MGS 2002 and the 7.25 percent MGS 2006 (II).
In corporate bonds, there were five deals in Mid-Med Bank 7.25 percent unsecured loan stock 2005 amounting to 25,069 Maltese Lira.
